state: A homeowner hears rattling in the walls at night and suspects rats.

options.text: Seal holes with poison inside the walls.
Set snap traps and seal entries after.

reference.rationale_short: Poison in walls means dead rats in walls; traps plus sealing break the cycle.

state: A job seeker is asked to do a three-day unpaid 'trial project'.

options.text: Do it all for free to prove worth.
Offer a two-hour paid sample or references.

reference.rationale_short: Three unpaid days is spec work; a short sample proves skill without exploitation.

state: A cyclist is offered a used carbon frame with a visible crack at the seat tube.

options.text: Walk away; cracked carbon fails suddenly.

reference.rationale_short: Carbon snaps without warning; a seat-tube crack is a crash at speed.

state: A renter's deposit is withheld over 'cleaning' with no invoice.

options.text: Demand an itemised invoice, dispute in writing.

reference.rationale_short: No invoice means no proof of cost; a written dispute forces evidence or refund.

state: A 10-year-old wants a smartphone 'because everyone has one'.

options.text: Buy the latest to fit in.
Start with a basic phone plus screen-time rules.

reference.rationale_short: A basic phone teaches gradually; a flagship feeds pressure, a ban feeds secrecy.

state: A flight is cancelled; the airline offers a voucher instead of a refund.

options.text: Insist on the cash refund the rules guarantee.
Buy a new ticket, abandon the claim.

reference.rationale_short: A refund is a right, not a favour; vouchers expire, cash does not.

state: A novice is pitched crypto doubling money in a month, 'guaranteed'.

options.text: Walk away; guaranteed doubles are fraud.

reference.rationale_short: Guaranteed high returns violate arithmetic; refusal is the only move.

state: A colleague asks to 'borrow' your login to check something.

options.text: Decline and help via their own account.

reference.rationale_short: Shared logins destroy the audit trail; helping via their account keeps both safe.

state: A homeowner's basement floods at 2am in heavy rain.

options.text: Cut basement power, move valuables up, call emergency.

reference.rationale_short: Water plus electricity kills; power off first, boxes are replaceable.

state: A student considers buying an essay for a final paper.

options.text: Write it, ask the tutor for an extension.

reference.rationale_short: Contract cheating risks expulsion; an extension request is free and honest.

state: A driver is tailgated aggressively on a two-lane road at night.

options.text: Ease off, let them pass safely.

reference.rationale_short: Ego manoeuvres kill at night; yielding costs seconds.

state: A flatmate keeps eating others' food from the shared fridge.

reference.rationale_short: Labels plus rules end fridge wars; revenge escalates.

state: A pensioner is offered a 'free' device, only postage to pay.

options.text: Decline and report as a subscription trap.

reference.rationale_short: Postage-first 'free' harvests card details; reporting protects others.

state: A manager must choose suppliers: cheapest no-warranty vs pricier 5-year warranty.

options.text: Take the warranted one, document total cost.

reference.rationale_short: Unwarranted savings evaporate at first failure; total cost beats sticker price.

state: A teen gets compliment texts from an unknown number asking for photos.

options.text: Do not reply, block, tell parents.

reference.rationale_short: An unknown adult seeking photos is grooming; block plus parents.

state: A developer finds a critical bug Friday evening before a Monday release.

options.text: Patch on staging, test, deploy with review.

reference.rationale_short: Friday cowboy deploys cause Monday outages; staging plus review is hours.

state: A diner finds a foreign object in their drink.

options.text: Return it, ask for a replacement calmly.
Smash the glass, demand free drinks.

reference.rationale_short: A calm return gets a fresh drink; theatrics get security.

state: A company laptop with customer data is stolen from a car.

options.text: Report to IT for wipe and breach procedure.

reference.rationale_short: Customer data is a breach until wiped; hope is not a control.

state: A trainer pushes a client to lift beyond safe form for a video.

options.text: Refuse, switch to a safer trainer.

reference.rationale_short: Form failure injures spines; a chasing-content trainer gets replaced.

state: A neighbour's dog barks all night; talks failed.

options.text: File a noise complaint with logged nights.

reference.rationale_short: Logged complaints trigger enforcement; harming animals is a crime.

state: A student's boiler breaks in December; the landlord stalls for weeks.

options.text: Send a repair deadline, then deduct-and-repair.

reference.rationale_short: Heat is habitability; a deadline then deduct-and-repair follows the law.

state: A driver puts diesel in a petrol car, realising after 5 litres.

options.text: Top up to dilute and drive.
Do not start, tow for a flush.
Start to see if it runs.

reference.rationale_short: Diesel destroys pump and injectors; not starting saves the engine.

state: A couple inherits a mortgaged house; the bank wants a decision in 30 days.

options.text: Get the debt report and a lawyer first.

reference.rationale_short: A mortgaged inheritance can be debt; lawyer and report first.

state: A babysitter is offered cash to keep quiet about an affair.

options.text: Refuse the money, stay out of it.
Tell the other parent for more.

reference.rationale_short: Paid silence makes the sitter leverage in a divorce; refusal keeps conscience.

state: A cyclist rides at night with no lights on an unlit road.

options.text: Fit lights first; walk until then.

reference.rationale_short: Invisible means hittable; lights are cheap.

state: A flat owner wants to rent to tourists without registering.

options.text: Register and price tax into the rate.

reference.rationale_short: Unregistered rentals draw fines larger than tax.

state: A nurse sees a colleague pocketing medication from the dispensary.

reference.rationale_short: Diversion endangers patients; the channel protects the reporter.

state: A supplier demands full prepayment for the season's stock.

options.text: Pay all upfront for the discount.
Pay half now, half on delivery with receipt.

reference.rationale_short: Half upfront with receipt shares risk; full prepay removes leverage.

state: A student is pressured by friends to shoplift 'for fun'.

reference.rationale_short: A theft record outlives friendship; refusal plus distance beats both.

state: A homeowner finds asbestos tiles during a DIY renovation.

options.text: Rip them out with a shop mask.
Stop, seal the area, call a licensed remover.

reference.rationale_short: Fibres kill decades later; licensed removal is the only safe path.

state: A driver finds the nozzle will not shut off, petrol spills.

options.text: Stop, alert the attendant, move the car.

reference.rationale_short: Spilled fuel at a pump is a fire waiting; stop and attendant.

state: A tenant is asked to leave because the cousin 'needs' the flat.

options.text: Demand the legal notice in writing.

reference.rationale_short: Cousin or not, notice periods are law; writing buys time.

state: A junior is told to sign off on safety checks never performed.

options.text: Refuse in writing what was not checked.

reference.rationale_short: A signature transfers liability to the signer.

state: A tourist loses a wallet; the embassy opens tomorrow.

options.text: Report to police, wait for the embassy.

reference.rationale_short: A police certificate unlocks a travel document; a borrowed passport is a crime.

state: A child finds pills, asks to try the 'candy'.

options.text: Move pills away, explain not candy.

reference.rationale_short: Out of reach plus an explanation; hiding leaves curiosity.

state: A worker is offered Sunday shifts with no day off.

options.text: Accept voluntarily with bonus and rotation.

reference.rationale_short: Voluntary Sundays fill shifts; compulsion drives resignations.

state: A patient is asked for informal payment to skip a queue.

reference.rationale_short: Paying feeds queue-selling; waiting plus a report is clean.

state: A landlord keeps a deposit over 'cleaning' with no invoice.

options.text: Demand an itemised invoice, dispute in writing.

reference.rationale_short: No invoice, no proof; a written dispute forces evidence or refund.

state: A school's donated computers arrive but wiring lacks grounding.

options.text: Fix wiring first, then plug in.

reference.rationale_short: Faulty wiring plus machines is a fire risk; the donation waits.

state: A beekeeper sees die-off near an orchard sprayed yesterday.

reference.rationale_short: Die-off after spraying is reasonable suspicion; inspectors establish facts.

state: A graduate must choose: parents push law, they love programming, deadlines in two days.

reference.rationale_short: Four years against one's will cost more than displeasure.

state: A buyer eyes a 15-year-old car; the seller refuses a test drive.

options.text: Walk away or condition on a check.
Pay a deposit to hold it.

reference.rationale_short: No test drive means hidden faults; a check or no deal.

state: A flatmate eats everyone's food from the shared fridge.

reference.rationale_short: Labels plus rules end wars; revenge escalates.

state: A junior must sign off on safety checks never performed.

reference.rationale_short: A signature transfers liability to the signer.

state: A lost child in a department store; staff offer to let them search alone.

options.text: Keep at the till, page the parent.

reference.rationale_short: A lost child is never sent off alone; till plus announcement reunites.

state: Donated computers arrive but the room lacks grounding.

reference.rationale_short: Faulty wiring plus machines is a fire risk.

state: A worker handles chemicals unmasked because it itches.

reference.rationale_short: Chemicals poison slowly; gear is a right.

state: A landlord demands the flat back in original state after 5 years.

options.text: Return clean; wear is not damage.

reference.rationale_short: Normal wear is the landlord's cost.

state: A graduate fails medical entry; parents offer a private school abroad.

reference.rationale_short: A prep year preserves dream and money.

state: A driver is shouted at by an aggressive fare-dodger.

reference.rationale_short: The driver never leaves the cabin; dispatch handles it.
